en: Colorized view over a calm lake with a small rowboat carrying two people in the foreground. On the opposite shore there is a line of trees, a large light‑colored building with red roofs to the left, and a few small red wooden houses along the shoreline to the right. The sky is pale blue and beige, and printed text at the upper left reads "Savonlinna – Pääskylahti." The image has a worn, vintage look typical of early 20th‑century postcards.
